title: Mitchell TTX · logistics under attack
subtitle: Dispersed CCA sustainment and constrained seven-day sortie mix
description: Source-based visualization of the TTX logistics assessment: CCA prepositioning, distributed operating sites, theater airlift risks, missile-threat exposure, and the effect of munitions limits on seven-day CCA sortie plans.
assumptions: The report locates notional forward operating areas in southern Japan and the northern Philippines, not named runways or precise bases.
Figure 12 compares seven-day plans: sweep weapon-launch sorties 96% unconstrained versus 68% constrained; SEAD 76% versus 33%.
Published TTX concepts and aggregate exercise results are sourced; the report does not disclose verified aircraft waypoints or flyable mission tracks.
Map positions, path geometry, animation duration and actor icons are deliberately schematic; presentation seconds are not elapsed operational hours.
Display actor counts are illustrative and must not be mistaken for the TTX's full force inventories or actual sortie totals.
